Package com.smartlostfound.controller

Class LostFoundController

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.controller.LostFoundController
public class LostFoundController extends Object
Central controller in the MVC architecture. Mediates user actions originating from Views, executes business rules and queries via LostFoundManager and UserManager, and updates View components accordingly.
